summary: SvgExternalSessionHost is a presentation-only callback host, not a simulation controller. Its pure policy separates mount generation from opaque external epoch, allocates acquisition IDs, accepts increasing revisions in the bound epoch and owns one acquisition plus one coalesced queued presentation. Same-epoch rebinding preserves the accepted revision baseline; different epochs reset it. Completion must match generation/epoch/acquisition, and disposal is inert thereafter. Public observations include CallbackFailureObserved and CancellationSettlementUnknown: cancel requested is not proof that external work settled. Native pause/reset/step and command receipts remain on the product gateway path, outside SVG presentation coalescing. Source/model/browser tests do not independently prove external engine or product acceptance.
title: External session host preserves simulation authority outside presentation
